steps.code: <?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; update_option('blogname', 'WG Soluções Audiovisuais'); foreach (get_posts(array('post_type' => 'post', 'post_status' => 'any', 'numberposts' => -1)) as $p) { wp_delete_post($p->ID, true); } foreach (array('sample-page', 'pagina-exemplo') as $slug) { $pg = get_page_by_path($slug); if ($pg) { wp_delete_post($pg->ID, true); } } wg_run_import(); flush_rewrite_rules();
